description.p: Hosts Manager is a native GNOME application for editing the system hosts file with profile overlays. Keep separate Development, Staging, and Production host lists and enable only what you need.
The graphical interface runs as your user account. Writes to /etc/hosts are performed through PolicyKit and a small privileged helper that validates input, creates backups, and writes atomically.

ul.li: Multiple profiles with per-host enable toggles
Inline descriptions stored as comments in the managed block
Preserves unmanaged lines outside the managed block
Diff review before saving (when auto-save is off)
Optional auto-save to write hosts immediately

description.p: Initial release with profile overlays, auto-save, and GNOME 46 support.
